5044-progress.name: Mangletooth
5044-progress.text:
The shaman and geomancers of the quilboar tribes <snort> call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, $r.

If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you. <snort>
5044-progress.title: Wisdom of Agamaggan

5045-progress.name: Mangletooth
5045-progress.text:
Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>
5045-progress.title: Rising Spirit

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

913-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
913-progress.text: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?
913-progress.title: Cry of the Thunderhawk

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

97003-complete.name: Gur'ak
97003-complete.text:
Impressive, $c. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.

Lok-tar!
97003-complete.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-progress.name: Gur'ak
97003-progress.text:
It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.

If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003-progress.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener
